answer_1.quote: Locating and repairing bugs of programs automatically is important in software engineering. Many approaches based on the Neural Machine Translation (NMT) have achieved promising performance for semantic bug fixing. The basic idea is to automatically translate a buggy code fragment into a fixed patch.
answer_1.outputs: Fixed code patches from buggy inputs

answer_2.quote: The programs are fixed correctly only if they are identical to their ground-truth fixed programs in the test set. The evaluation metric is accuracy.
